title: SIMAI Framework documentation site
summary: A bilingual static SIMAI Framework site with locale product landings, first-level header navigation and a full documentation tree generated from repository-owned Markdown and validated configuration. The canonical Russian ordinary-component route is /ru/components/: it is a flat 63-page section with a task-grouped index, reference authoring profile and redirects from the former /ru/framework-components/ hierarchy. Optional source-backed tracking reports whether Russian Core, utility, component and Smart Component pages and examples match the exact pinned Framework runtime without changing the separate translation workflow.
